targetPopulation: Public https sites drawn from the frozen frame at calibration/pixel-events-2026-08/frame.json: consumer retail, news, health-commerce, and reference sites that served two successful unauthenticated automated desktop visits during the preregistered reliability sweep. Rates describe this frame population only, under the fixed accept-all measurement arm, and are never an all-visitors or all-web estimate.

design.selectionProtocol: Frame of exactly 400 sites drawn by seeded simple random sampling from the reliability-screened candidate pool defined in docs/calibration-prereg-drafts/frame-construction.md: a fixed pool of 600+ candidates composed half from likely-pixel strata (retail, news, health commerce) and half from likely-clean strata (reference, government, open source), every candidate having passed two pre-freeze automated visits under the exact measurement condition. The random seed is the SHA-256 of this study's committed preregistration.json, computed after commit and recorded in the frame tooling output, so the draw is deterministic, reproducible, and fixed before any acquisition.
design.referenceProtocol: Each labeler independently reviews the blinded per-case evidence bundle (distinct third-party requests: host, path, method, count; no detector output, no prediction, no site identity beyond the recorded hosts) and asserts present when the evidence shows a request matching a documented advertising-pixel endpoint pattern for Meta, TikTok, or X as defined in docs/calibration-prereg-drafts/labeling-protocol.md, and absent otherwise. Labels are sealed to the study public key before acquisition begins and revealed only by the protected assembly lane.
design.adjudicationProtocol: Two through ten distinct GitHub actors label every case independently and blind to each other. One additional distinct actor precommits a blind tiebreaker source before acquisition. Agreements stand as final. Any disagreement is resolved by the precommitted tiebreaker alone, recorded as disagreement-resolved-by-blind-tiebreaker with the tiebreaker identity and artifact digest; no post-hoc discussion, relabeling, or majority vote occurs.

measurementCondition.interpretation: Rates are conditional on desktop visits where accept-all registration was verified and reverified after reload, with GPC disabled.
